name: io.github.nebeleben/plaiiinlight-mcp
title: PlaiiinLight lamps
description: Control PlaiiinLight LED lamps on your local network: colour, effects, images, scenes, firmware.

packageArguments.name: --profile
packageArguments.description: A short name for the AI program you are setting up, for example gemini or cursor (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens). Required: each profile keeps its own lamp list and its own lamp keys, so use a different name in each program.
